sentences.en: A winter sport that many people enjoy is ice skating.
sentences.zh: 许多人喜欢的一项冬季运动是滑冰。

sentences.en: Put on your skates, I just waxed the wood floor.
sentences.zh: 穿上你的溜冰鞋，我刚刚给木地板打了一层蜡。

sentences.en: For me, skiing is by far more interesting than skating.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，滑雪比滑冰有趣得多。
